articles.summary: Cyabra’s research on five competitive 2026 midterm races found that inauthentic activity on X peaked on Election Day, when fabricated Michigan and Ohio results drew 3.4 million views before polls closed.
articles.title: How Fake Results Outran the Count on Election Day

articles.summary: Based on a talk by Cyabra’s CEO Dan Brahmy at AMEC 2026, this article covers how inauthentic accounts amplify real complaints, what the Cracker Barrel and American Eagle backlashes reveal, and how to decide whether to respond based on which concerns are authentic and who is driving them.
articles.title: Ignore, Monitor, or Escalate: Deciding When a Backlash Deserves a Response
